Blue Apron is a meal-kit company that delivered subscription boxes of pre-portioned ingredients and recipes to US households. It listed on the NYSE (APRN) in 2017, struggled, and was acquired by Wonder Group in 2023 for about 103 million dollars. It was headquartered in New York. Funding recorded is about $422 million. It was a well known consumer meal-kit brand in the US with heavy advertising earlier on, now operating as part of Wonder.

Paack is a Barcelona based tech-driven last-mile delivery company handling e-commerce parcels for retailers in Spain, Portugal, France and Italy, using a network of drivers and parcel lockers. Founded in 2017, it focused on same-day and next-day delivery for merchants. It raised about $368 million including a 2022 round from Infravia and others. Its current ownership status should be checked. It is a B2B logistics brand with low consumer awareness.

It is a consumer-facing franchise brand with regional visibility.

about: HungryPanda is a London based food delivery platform serving Chinese and Asian restaurants for overseas Chinese and international students in the UK, US, Europe, Australia, Japan and other countries, via an app. It was founded in 2016 and has expanded to groceries and has raised about $275 million, from investors including Dragoneer and Tiger-linked groups. It is a niche consumer brand with strong awareness among Chinese diaspora communities, and sponsors some events.

Spyglass Pharma is an Aliso Viejo, California specialty ophthalmic pharmaceutical company developing a drug-delivery implant that releases glaucoma medication over months to replace daily eye drops. It is a clinical-stage company, with products under development rather than on sale, and has raised funding of about $185 million. Its customers would be eye surgeons and patients with glaucoma. It is a private B2B biopharma firm with no consumer awareness.

about: Everli (formerly Supermercato24) is a Milan based online grocery marketplace where personal shoppers pick and deliver goods from local supermarkets such as Carrefour, Esselunga and Conad, with operations in Italy, Poland, France and other European countries. Founded in 2014, it has raised about $167 million from investors including Insight Partners and Verlinvest. It earns commissions and delivery fees. It is a consumer grocery delivery brand with considerable awareness in Italy.

VTG is a Hamburg based European rail logistics and wagon-hire company, which owns and leases a fleet of about 90,000 railcars, plus tank containers and a rail logistics arm, for the chemical, oil, agri and automotive industries. It is owned by Warburg Pincus and Morgan Stanley Infrastructure after a 2017-2018 takeover, and delisted from the stock market. Funding shown is about 2.9 billion euros. It is a B2B rail asset company with no consumer brand awareness.

CPV Generation Holdings is the holding entity for a portfolio of natural gas power plants owned by Competitive Power Ventures, a US developer and operator of power generation and renewable energy projects. The input describes it as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary and shows limited details. It earns revenue from selling electricity and capacity into US wholesale markets. B2B power producer with no consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Navios Maritime Partners is a Greece-linked international shipping company, a publicly traded master limited partnership (NYSE: NMM) that owns and charters a large fleet of dry bulk vessels, containerships and tankers. Controlled by Angeliki Frangou's Navios group, it is based in Piraeus, Greece (with a Monaco address) and operates about 150 vessels on charters to commodity traders, container lines and oil companies. B2B shipping owner with no consumer brand profile.

Cabify is a Spanish ride-hailing and mobility company founded in 2011 in Madrid, offering app-based taxi and private car services mainly in Spain and Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Argentina and others). Customers are consumers and corporate travel accounts. Backed by investors including Rakuten, Santander and Korea's Mirae, with a valuation of about 1.4 billion dollars at peak. Recognisable consumer app in Spanish-speaking markets, with experience in sports sponsorship such as football.

Ceske Drahy (Czech Railways, CD) is the Czech Republic's national railway passenger operator, based in Prague, running domestic and international passenger trains, with the freight business, CD Cargo, now separated. It carries well over 150 million passengers a year and is wholly owned by the Czech state, competing with private operators such as RegioJet. High consumer visibility in the Czech Republic.

COSCO Shipping is a Chinese state-owned shipping and logistics group headquartered in Shanghai, formed by the 2016 merger of COSCO and China Shipping. It operates one of the world's largest fleets of container ships, bulk carriers and tankers through COSCO Shipping Holdings (Hong Kong: 1919), with port terminals and logistics, and is owned by China's SASAC. B2B, operating globally, with awareness among shippers and no consumer brand profile.

Galaxy Container Solutions is a US-based logistics company in Boston, Massachusetts, which the Crunchbase description presents as a commercial shipping and container logistics provider. No scale, customers, products or ownership details are supported by the input. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Kuehne + Nagel is a Swiss global logistics group headquartered in Schindellegi, offering sea logistics, air logistics, road logistics and contract logistics in over 100 countries, with about 80,000 employees and revenue of roughly 25 billion Swiss francs. Customers are exporters, importers and manufacturers. Founded in 1890 in Bremen, it is listed on SIX Swiss Exchange (KNIN) and controlled by Klaus-Michael Kuehne. B2B with visible sponsorship in sport, including Hamburg football, and a track record with Formula 1-adjacent logistics.

Rand Logistics was a US bulk shipping company that operated a fleet of dry bulk and tanker vessels on the Great Lakes, carrying cargoes such as grain, salt, coal and stone between the US and Canada via subsidiaries like Lower Lakes Towing. It was based in New York and listed on Nasdaq (RLOG) before filing for bankruptcy in 2018 and being sold. B2B service with no consumer profile.

VLI is a Brazilian logistics operator based in Belo Horizonte that integrates rail, ports and terminals to move agricultural and industrial cargo such as grain, fertiliser, sugar, steel and fuel. It operates freight railways including FCA and FNS and terminals at ports such as Santos and Sao Luis. Shareholders include Vale, Mitsui, Brookfield and a government investment fund (FI-FGTS). B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

about: Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Singapore-based container shipping line formed in 2017 by combining the container businesses of Japan's NYK, MOL and K Line. It operates roughly 200 vessels carrying standard and refrigerated containers on routes worldwide, selling to exporters and freight forwarders. It is a private company owned by the three Japanese parents. B2B, known among shippers, not consumers, but it has done some sports sponsorship.

NextNRG is a US energy technology company based in Miami, Florida, previously EzFill, offering mobile fuel delivery, wireless EV charging, microgrids and AI-managed energy infrastructure. It sells fuel delivery to consumers and fleets via an app, and is listed on Nasdaq (NXXT). Small consumer-facing brand with limited national awareness.

P N Gadgil Jewellers is an Indian jewellery retailer based in Pune, founded in 1832, selling gold, silver, diamond and platinum jewellery through a network of around 40 or more stores in Maharashtra and other states plus online. It listed on the NSE and BSE in September 2024 (PNGJL). Strong regional consumer brand in western India, a sponsor of cultural events.

Sihamba Sonke Mobility operates and modernises mobility services, according to the Crunchbase text, in the fleet management and logistics industries. It is based in Gauteng, South Africa. Funding shown is ZAR 9 million. Its customers and ownership are not stated in the input. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Rumo is a Brazilian railway and logistics operator, based in Indaiatuba, Sao Paulo state, that hauls agricultural commodities such as soy, corn and sugar to Santos port and runs terminals. Part of Cosan group, it has a network of about 14,000 km of rail. Listed on the B3 exchange (RAIL3). B2B with low consumer awareness.

Cimko is a Turkish cement and construction materials producer, part of the Sanko group, based in Gaziantep. It makes cement and offers ready-mix concrete and waste recovery as alternative fuels. Customers are builders and contractors across Turkey and nearby markets. B2B with regional visibility.

about: Landstar System is a US asset-light transportation and logistics company, based in Jacksonville, Florida, using a network of thousands of independent owner-operators and agents to move freight by truck, rail, air and ocean, with revenue of about $5 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (LSTR). Customers are shippers. B2B with a modest brand profile in freight.

Switzer-Carty Transportation is a Canadian passenger transportation company, based in Bradford, Ontario, providing scheduled and charter bus services, including school buses and motorcoaches. Funding shown is about $300 million. Customers are school boards, groups and commuters. Regional consumer-facing brand in Ontario.

about: CargoX is a blockchain-based platform for electronic bills of lading and trade documents, originally Slovenian, with Crunchbase listing Abu Dhabi. Customers are shipping lines, shippers and banks. Funding shown is about $250 million, perhaps in token terms. B2B with a low consumer profile.

about: KNOT Offshore Partners is a shipping company that owns and operates shuttle tankers carrying crude oil from offshore fields in the North Sea, Brazil and elsewhere to onshore terminals, on long-term charters to oil majors such as Equinor, Shell and Petrobras. Offices in Aberdeen, Scotland, and listed on the NYSE (KNOP). Controlled by Knutsen NYK Offshore Tankers. B2B with no consumer profile.

Touax is a French company, based at La Defense near Paris, that leases and sells transport equipment such as shipping containers, modular buildings, river barges and railcars to customers in Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas. Listed on Euronext Paris (TOUP). B2B with no consumer profile.

Norfolk Southern Corporation is one of the largest US freight railroads, operating about 19,000 route miles in 22 states and Washington DC, and serving most major eastern ports. It carries intermodal, coal, automotive, chemicals, agricultural and industrial goods for shippers. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, it has around 20,000 employees and revenue of roughly 12 billion dollars. Listed on the NYSE (NSC). Union Pacific announced a plan to acquire it in 2025. Known for the 2023 East Palestine derailment. B2B transport brand with moderate public recognition in the eastern US.

Flash Express is a Thai logistics company that operates a parcel and express delivery network in Thailand, delivering e-commerce parcels to consumers and small businesses with a large fleet of vans and a network of branches. Founded in 2018 by Komsan Lee and backed by Chinese investors including Alibaba affiliates and Mubadala, it expanded into Malaysia, Laos and the Philippines. Headquartered in Bangkok, with funding of about 780 million dollars. It handles millions of parcels daily. Moderately known as a delivery brand in Thailand.

Lobito Atlantic Railway is the operator of the Lobito Corridor rail line in Angola, running from the Atlantic port of Lobito east to the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the aim of linking copper and cobalt mines of Congo and Zambia to the sea. It won a 30-year concession in 2022, held by a consortium of Trafigura, Mota-Engil and Vecturis, and received US and European financing as part of a Lobito Corridor initiative. Based in Lobito, Angola. B2B freight operator and mining logistics with no consumer visibility.

Licious is an Indian direct-to-consumer meat and seafood brand, founded in 2015 in Bengaluru, that sells fresh chicken, mutton, fish and ready-to-cook products through an app and cold-chain delivery network in major cities. It is one of India's first meat-tech unicorns, with backers including Temasek, Bertelsmann, Multiples and 3one4 Capital, valued at about 1.5 billion dollars in 2021. It plans an IPO. Well-known urban consumer food brand, with celebrity marketing in India.

Halan is an Egyptian ride-hailing and lifestyle app based in Sheikh Zayed, Giza, offering motorbike and tuk-tuk rides, delivery services and consumer financing products across Egyptian cities. Funding of about 228 million dollars, including debt and equity, is shown. Strong local consumer brand in Egypt, with ties to fintech lending.

about: Nana is a Saudi quick-commerce and grocery delivery platform from Riyadh, offering app-based delivery of groceries and household items from partner stores and dark stores to consumers in Saudi Arabia, plus the pharmacy and health items. Founded in 2016, it is one of the leading grocery apps in the kingdom and has raised over $200 million, including Series C money from investors such as Tiger Global. Revenue is from order margins and delivery fees. Well-known regional consumer brand.

Maison Solutions is a Monterey Park, California grocery operator that runs Asian-American and Hispanic supermarkets in Southern California, including Good Fortune Supermarket and Greenland Market, and offers delivery. It was listed on Nasdaq under MSS in 2023, and generates revenue of about $200 million from store sales. Customers are local community shoppers. Regional retail business with limited awareness beyond Southern California.

Ryde Group is a Singapore carpooling and ride-hailing app operator that connects riders with private-car and taxi drivers, along with a delivery and advertising business. It is listed on the NYSE American under RYDE after a 2023 IPO. Customers are Singapore commuters and corporate clients, and funding of about $32 million is shown. Revenue is from commissions and fees. Consumer app with moderate brand awareness in Singapore.

Stef is a French specialist in temperature-controlled logistics and transport, running refrigerated warehouses and a truck fleet that moves fresh and frozen food for retailers and manufacturers across Europe, with maritime activity under Stef Seafood. Headquartered in Paris, it is listed on Euronext Paris, with about 20,000 employees and revenue of several billion euros. Customers are food companies and supermarkets. B2B with little public brand awareness.

JD Property is the infrastructure asset manager within JD.com's logistics business, based in Beijing, that owns and manages logistics parks and warehouses used by JD Logistics and third parties, and raises funds backed by logistics real estate. Crunchbase shows funding of about $1.5 billion. Customers are e-commerce and supply chain operators. B2B real estate arm of a consumer internet group, with low independent brand awareness.

about: Convoy was a Seattle digital freight network that matched truckload shipments with trucking carriers using an app and algorithms, backed by Bezos Expeditions, Jeff Bezos and Marc Benioff, and valued at about $3.8 billion in 2022. It abruptly shut down in October 2023 after running out of cash, and Flexport acquired its technology and customer relationships. Funding raised was about $1.1 billion. B2B logistics technology with limited consumer awareness, now defunct.
